name: Supply-chain alert campaign with a fail-closed gate audit
description: BP-SEC-04 (card 64). Defining mechanism: a second-order AUDIT OF THE GATE. Every other multi-repo campaign reads each repo's CI verdict and stops; this one then audits those verdicts and reclassifies three specific fail-open readings - a repo reporting CLEAN with checks:NONE is UNGATED not passing, mergeStateStatus BLOCKED means the checks RAN AND FAILED not that they are pending, and a non-zero non-1 scanner exit (127) is a tool error not a finding count of zero. The measured near-miss this exists to prevent is a fail-open gate that almost let a fork-sync delete the estate's own security fixes. Replay is deliberately declared NON-deterministic because advisory data is time-varying; the snapshot date is the record.

repos.description: Fan-out keys - one campaign runner per repo, in owner/name form

advisory_source.description: Where alerts come from. If the source is unreachable the campaign HALTS rather than reporting zero alerts.

floor_policy.description: Which version floor a bump proposes; also the dedupe key's second component

snapshot_date.description: The advisory snapshot this campaign is pinned to. Without it a re-run silently measures a different world.

propose_only.description: PRs are opened as drafts and never auto-merged. Release mode on this estate is PR-only.

min_repo_quorum.description: Fraction of repos that must produce a gate verdict before the central audit may run

alert-collector.description: Pulls the advisory snapshot and halts loudly if the source is unreachable

repo-runner.description: Proposes one repo's bump as a draft PR and reads that repo's REAL CI result

gate-auditor.description: Audits the gate itself; the only role allowed to overturn a repo's self-reported PASS

owner.description: The human owner - merges, since release mode is PR-only

routes.reason: the gate audit must not share the runner's reading of its own CI output

advisory-source-live.expression: advisory_source_reachable == true AND alerts_collected >= 0 AND collector_exit_class != TOOL-ERROR

stages.title: Pull the pinned advisory snapshot, or halt

work_unit.title: Collect the advisory snapshot and classify the collector's own exit code
work_unit.question_or_target: Pull alerts for every repo from advisory_source at snapshot_date, and classify the collector's exit: 0 with alerts, 1 with findings, and ANY other non-zero (notably 127) as TOOL-ERROR. A tool error must halt the campaign; it must never be reported as zero alerts.
work_unit.evidence_requirement: the literal exit code of every advisory query plus the snapshot_date echoed from the tool output, so a zero-alert result is distinguishable from a query that never ran
tests_required: a scanner stubbed to exit 127 must halt the campaign, not report zero alerts
an unreachable advisory source must halt, not produce an empty alert set
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the gate auditor independently re-queries one repo and compares the alert count
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6401 when every query has a classified exit and the snapshot date is recorded; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6401 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to the other advisory source; never degrade to an empty set

stages.title: An unreachable advisory source is not a clean estate
Collapse alerts by (package, floor) - mechanically, not by judgement

work_unit.title: Deduplicate alerts by the (package, floor) key with an exact algorithm
work_unit.question_or_target: Group alerts by the exact tuple (package_name, resolved_floor_under_floor_policy) and emit one row per group with its member advisory ids; this is set membership, so it is computed by an algorithm and never delegated to model judgement.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the reduction is mechanical; the model writes and runs the reducer rather than performing it

work_unit.evidence_requirement: input alert count, output group count, and the sum of group members equal to the input count - a reduction that loses rows is visible as an arithmetic mismatch
tests_required: two advisories for the same package resolving to the same floor must collapse to one group
two advisories for the same package resolving to DIFFERENT floors must NOT collapse
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the member-sum identity is re-computed independently of the reducer that produced it
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6402 when the member sum equals the input alert count; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6402 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - an arithmetic mismatch is a reducer bug

body.title: For a fork, verify sync DIRECTION before merging anything upstream

work_unit.title: Verify fork sync direction so an upstream merge cannot delete local security fixes
work_unit.question_or_target: For a fork, compute ahead_by and behind_by in BOTH directions and require that no commit unique to this fork would be lost by the proposed sync; a one-directional read of ahead_by cannot see that the fork also holds unique content.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a direction misread here deletes security fixes

work_unit.evidence_requirement: both ahead_by and behind_by, plus the list of commits unique to the fork; a single number is not a direction
tests_required: a fork holding a unique local commit must be flagged even when it is also behind upstream (the two-directional control)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the gate auditor re-derives the unique-commit list with a different command
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6403 when both directions and the unique-commit list are recorded; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6403 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on an ambiguous direction - it escalates

body.title: Open the floor bump as a DRAFT PR - never auto-merge
Read that repo's ACTUAL check runs, not its merge-state summary

work_unit.title: Record the repo's real check-run conclusions and the count of required contexts
work_unit.question_or_target: Record every check run with its conclusion and the number of REQUIRED contexts configured for the branch; record mergeStateStatus separately and never as a substitute, because BLOCKED means the checks ran and failed while UNKNOWN means nothing at all.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the CI reading is what the whole campaign gates on

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the per-check conclusion list AND the required-context count as two separate fields; an empty check list with a CLEAN merge state must be recorded as both, not merged into one verdict
tests_required: a repo with zero configured checks must record checks:NONE, not PASS
mergeStateStatus BLOCKED with a failed check run must record the failure, not pending
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the gate auditor is the only role permitted to convert this record into a PASS or UNGATED verdict
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6404 when the check list and the required-context count are both present; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6404 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to the run-list API; a tool auth failure is a detector failure, never a verdict

stages.title: Audit the gate itself - the defining stage of this blueprint

work_unit.title: Reclassify every fail-open CI reading into an explicit UNGATED verdict
work_unit.question_or_target: For each repo convert the raw CI record into exactly one of PASS, FAIL or UNGATED, applying three inversions: zero configured required contexts is UNGATED regardless of any CLEAN summary; BLOCKED with a failed run is FAIL not pending; a tool auth failure while reading CI is UNGATED not PASS. Report the list of UNGATED repos as a first-class output.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cross-vendor so the audit does not inherit the runner's reading of its own output

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per repo: the raw fields that drove the verdict quoted verbatim, plus which of the three inversions (if any) was applied
tests_required: a repo with checks:NONE and a CLEAN merge state must audit to UNGATED (the fail-open control)
a repo with a genuinely passing required context must audit to PASS (the detector must not simply always say UNGATED)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner reads the UNGATED list before any merge; an UNGATED repo may not be merged on the strength of this campaign
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:SEC-6405 when every repo with a raw record has exactly one audited verdict and the UNGATED list is emitted; otherwise FAILED:SEC-6405 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry - a missing raw record is reported as repos_without_verdict, not retried into existence

stages.title: Absence of checks is UNGATED, never a pass
Report per repo, with the UNGATED list first
Campaign completion predicate (10 of 12 conditions; 7 and 8 are owner-side)

impact.blast_radius: opens draft PRs in every listed repo; nothing merges without the owner, because release mode on this estate is PR-only

mechanism_fingerprint.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-IMP-05 is the generic propose-only fleet build. The mechanism here is not the proposing; it is auditing the verdicts the proposals were gated on, and inverting three specific fail-open readings.

worked_example.name: a five-repo urllib3 floor bump where one repo has no CI at all
worked_example.narrative: Nine advisories collapse to three (package, floor) groups. Four repos open draft PRs; gamma-fork's direction check finds two commits unique to the fork that an upstream sync would have deleted, so its bump is proposed as a cherry-pick instead. delta reports mergeStateStatus CLEAN with an empty check list - the audit reclassifies it UNGATED, which trips the fail-closed gate and escalates to the owner rather than reporting five green repos. epsilon's CI read fails on a token scope; that is a detector failure, so epsilon is UNGATED too, not PASS. Final verdicts: 3 PASS, 0 FAIL, 2 UNGATED - and the campaign's own headline is the UNGATED list, not the PASS count.
